units.source_text: 后来我就没有再见到那个出家人和姑娘们。

en.t: After that, I never saw that monk or the girls again.

units.source_text: 不过，在大竹的马戏棚里，也不得不让马戏姑娘跳八木小调舞了。

en.t: But even in Otake's circus tent, they had to make the circus girls dance to the Yagi kouta.

units.source_text: 那时节，是江川的全盛期，一个名叫海和尚的出家人在江川唱《八木小调》，

en.t: At that time Egawa was at the height of its popularity, and a monk called Umi-osho was singing Yagi kouta there,

units.source_text: 他是个敲大鼓的，声望很高。

en.t: he was a big-drum player and had a great reputation.

units.source_text: 可是，今夏观世音的四万六千日这天，在驹込的大观音寺那里，以及秋节在根津的权现神社那里，

en.t: Yet this summer, on Kannon's Forty-Six Thousand Days at Daikannonji in Komagome, and at the autumn festival at Nezu Gongen Shrine,

units.source_text: 我看到一个遭冷落的和尚。

en.t: I saw a monk who had fallen out of favor.

units.source_text: 他装束像个艺人，罩着一件陈旧的紫色绉绸外褂，挂着一副一本正经的面孔，

en.t: He was dressed like a performer, wearing an old purple crepe outer robe and a solemn, self-important expression,

units.source_text: 却率领着一伙比乞丐还脏的男男女女，走出了表演节目的戏棚。

en.t: yet he led a group of men and women dirtier than beggars out of the performance tent.

units.source_text: 在根津，从戏棚前拉起的帷幕缝隙里窥视，

en.t: At Nezu, peering through a gap in the curtain drawn up in front of the tent,

units.source_text: 只见戏棚里有不足二十个脏兮兮的小观众，还有土间里的青草和舞台。

en.t: I saw fewer than twenty dirty little spectators inside, along with the green grass on the earthen floor and the stage.
